about: Opponent PROFILE rows (Strategy 2026-10-27; the donor pattern of AzerothCore creature_template and EQEmu npc_types): the unit a fight is built from. A row names who he is (`opponent`: a V1 roster id, src/fight/moves.ts OPPONENTS), the body he is drawn in (`body`, below), the brain laid over his V1 AI profile (`brain`: a data/brains.json row id, or null = V1's profile as it is) and his stat scales at 100 % (foeHealthScale, foeDamageScale; a difficulty row's scales multiply these). A difficulty row (data/difficulty.json) overrides the brain knobs and scales on top of one profile. `body` (Dom 2026-10-27: 'switch in a different boss with one or two lines'): the Mixamo 106 body the profile is drawn in, a key of data/rig.json `files` (a 65 body stem) whose 106 file also has a data/rig.json clips106.dir folder; a row with none gets `defaultBody` (the Minotaur, today's boss). src/fight/foe-body.ts reads it; src/sim/validate.js checkBodies rejects an unknown or clip-less body (and src/fight/foe-body.ts throws at load on the same check); ?<bodyQuery>=<body> (?boss=psyche) swaps the body for one page view (a preview flag, the default row unchanged). One body per opponent id: two profiles on one `opponent` cannot name different bodies. Which bodies are drop-in today, and what a new one needs: docs/BOSS-BODIES.md. The weapon and specials are still V1's rows for `opponent` (the Pitborn's cleaver and Earth Fold). The fight config is { profile id, difficulty row id } (data/fight.json `profile`, data/difficulty.json `default`, ?difficulty=): plain data, deterministic, so a server can choose both per encounter. PvP uses neither.

profiles.about: The level-18 Pitborn (V3's Minotaur): V1's cleaver, stats and class special; his skill knobs come from the difficulty row (brain null = V1's own for anything a row leaves out: spamRun 6).
